invariants.rationale: Method returns a table object, which is generally expected to be non-null unless by design.
The method directly passes config to another method; config must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
The storageConf parameter is directly passed to helper methods, so it is expected to be non-null.
It is common for the created table to reference the same config object passed in.
Typically, table creation methods set the table's name from the configuration.
